dateline: Baltimore, Maryland, USA — ARIRANG World Tour two-night stand at M&T Bank Stadium (Aug 10-11); Maryland Governor Wes Moore welcomes the group; Toronto City Council approves temporary 'BTS Boulevard' renaming ahead of Aug 22-23 Rogers Stadium shows; next stops: Arlington AT&T Stadium (Aug 15-16), Toronto Rogers Stadium (Aug 22-23)
heroHeadline: Day 4,806: ARIRANG Tour Opens Baltimore Stand as Toronto Approves 'BTS Boulevard'
heroSubtitle: August 10, 2026 is Day 4,806 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. The ARIRANG World Tour's North American return leg arrives in Baltimore for a two-night run at M&T Bank Stadium (Aug 10-11), with Maryland Governor Wes Moore welcoming the group via video message: "Seven guys with one mission — bringing the world together and transcending cultural, geographical and language barriers." The stop follows sold-out dates at MetLife Stadium (Aug 1-2) and Gillette Stadium (Aug 5-6), and precedes AT&T Stadium in Arlington (Aug 15-16) and Rogers Stadium in Toronto (Aug 22-23) — where City Council has approved temporarily renaming a stretch of Yonge Street 'BTS Boulevard' from Aug 21-Sep 23 and asked Mayor Olivia Chow to proclaim 'BTS Weekend.' The tour continues to build on a record-breaking summer: HYBE posted its best-ever quarter in Q2 2026 (concert revenue up 243% year-over-year) on the tour's strength, while 'SWIM' has tied 'Dynamite' for BTS's longest-ever run atop the Billboard Global (Excl. US) chart.
